appliesTo: positioned elements, flex and grid items
summary: Paint order within the current stacking context.
details: Higher values paint on top, but only against siblings in the same stacking context. A parent that forms a context (opacity, transform, isolation, or position with a z-index) caps all its children.

values.note: Below siblings, above the context background.

gotcha: z-index: 9999 cannot escape a parent stacking context. Fix the parent, not the number.
